storage_check.title: Check the file
storage_check.description: The file holds no orphaned component row and no reference to an entity that is not there. Both are invisible to every query — a read starts from the spine — so this asks the connection: whether foreign keys are being enforced, which rows violate one, and what SQLite's own integrity check says.

archetype_check.title: Check the archetype pointers
archetype_check.description: Every archetype pointer matches the components its owner actually wears. A writer that lands rows past the graph without naming the owners it touched leaves a pointer the read door and the query planner both believe.
